title: Persist session skill overlays and visible-context ledgers
objective: Persist session overrides, announced catalog state, loaded body digests, and context epoch across save/resume without claiming invisible history is still loaded.
context: Implement the accepted hybrid skill catalog design in the dirty shared worktree.
Registry state is authoritative; prompt messages are an append-only model projection and never the authorization boundary.

source_evidence.note: Bounded metadata catalog and on-demand full skill content.
Live discovery and four-state skill visibility controls.
Append-only messages preserve the prior cached prefix.

include: Add an optional backward-compatible SessionSkillsMeta to SessionMeta.
Persist session overrides, announced revision/entry digests, loaded digests, and context_epoch.
Make SaveMeta partial merges preserve the field.
Invalidate cursors/loaded ledgers when the corresponding messages are not in visible history.
exclude: Do not modify files owned by another task.
Do not add dependencies or perform unrelated refactors.

implementation_steps: Add sidecar helpers and minimal SessionMeta field.
Add old-JSON, round-trip, partial-merge, resume, and epoch mismatch tests.
Keep model message reconstruction in later loop/compact tasks.
acceptance_criteria: Old sessions load with zero skill state.
Session overlays remain isolated and resume correctly.
A cursor or loaded digest from a different context epoch cannot suppress a required snapshot/body.
dispatch_prompt: Add backward-compatible SessionSkillsMeta persistence, including context_epoch-bound catalog and loaded-digest ledgers. Modify only session-owned files.
notes_for_assignee: Respect owned_files. Escalate contract gaps to the integration owner rather than editing another task's production files.
